sys_atf_test.description: Enables outbound webhooks, creates a Torq-sourced case with severity=3 and state=1, then updates BOTH severity to 1 AND state to 3 in a single update. Asserts the webhook_log payload contains event_type case.severity_changed (not case.state_changed), confirming the business rule priority order: severity > state > reassigned > updated.
sys_atf_test.name: Severity Change Takes Priority Over State Change
